questions.question: In the summary, what does the term "capex" mean?
options: Capital expenditure, money spent to buy or improve assets
questions.explain_en: "Capex" is short for capital expenditure, the money a company spends to acquire or upgrade physical assets.
questions.explain_zh: 「capex」是 capital expenditure（資本支出）的縮寫，指公司用來購買或升級實體資產的費用。

questions.question: In the text, what does the word "installments" mean?
options: Paying the amount in several smaller parts over time
Paying the whole amount at once
